2608.29705.title: A Calibration Audit of Confidence in Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
2608.29705.paper_summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models emit a per-pixel confidence that downstream systems read as a reliability signal. It is trained as a loss weight, not as an uncertainty magnitude, and whether it can be used as an error prediction has not been measured. We audit seven released backbones on thirteen datasets and score the confidence on four properties, how well it ranks error, whether its level is right on average, whether it holds across the confidence range, and whether its intervals cover the truth. The confidence ranks error well, but the predicted uncertainty is too low when it is read under conditions that are not exactly those of training. The median case is off by 2.4x across all seven models, and the error prediction is further off the more confident the model is. We show that this phenomenon can appear even though the loss's optimum is reached. A released model resumed under its own loss reaches that optimum on its training data within a few hundred updates and stays overconfident on unseen frames. A power law with two constants per backbone and dataset corrects the overall magnitude of the predicted uncertainty and leaves the ranking untouched. What no rescaling reaches is the scene, which we attribute to the model's missing knowledge of scale across predictions. Every correction we tried is close to right on average and still leaves two thirds of held-out scenes outside a five-point band, because what a scene is missing is a shape rather than a shift. We release the audit protocol, its results, and the fitted constants per model and dataset. Fitted with the target dataset held out, the constants bring the median case from 2.4x off to 1.35x, and a refit on a few labelled scenes of that dataset reaches 1.12x.
2608.29705.paper_summary_zh: 前饋式三維重建模型發出每個像素的信心，供下游系統作為可靠性信號來讀取。它被訓練為損失權重，而不是不確定性大小，且是否可以用作錯誤預測尚未被測量。我們對七個已發布的骨幹在十三個數據集上進行審核，並在四個屬性上對信心進行評分，包括它在錯誤排名上的表現、其平均水平是否正確、在信心範圍內是否保持一致，以及其區間是否涵蓋真實情況。信心在錯誤排名上表現良好，但在不完全符合訓練條件的情況下，預測的不確定性過低。所有七個模型的中位數情況偏差為2.4倍，且模型越自信，錯誤預測的偏差越大。我們顯示這一現象即使在損失的最佳值達成後仍然會出現。一個在其自身損失下重新訓練的模型在幾百次更新內達到其訓練數據的最佳值，並在未見過的幀上保持過度自信。每個骨幹和數據集的兩個常數的冪律修正了預測不確定性的整體大小，並保持了排名不變。沒有重新縮放所能達到的是場景，我們將其歸因於模型在預測中缺乏對比例的知識。我們嘗試的每個修正平均上都接近正確，但仍然使三分之二的保留場景位於五點帶之外，因為場景缺少的是形狀而不是位移。我們發布了審核協議、其結果以及每個模型和數據集的擬合常數。將目標數據集保留的常數擬合後，中位數情況從2.4倍偏差降至1.35倍，而在該數據集的幾個標記場景上重新擬合達到1.12倍。
